name: Atea ASA
summary: Atea ASA, founded in Oslo, Norway, in 1968, specializes in delivering comprehensive IT infrastructure solutions and related services. The company primarily serves enterprises and public sector organizations throughout the Nordic and Baltic regions. Their extensive portfolio encompasses: Data Center and Information Management: They offer essential hardware and software for storing and overseeing information, alongside tools for data center operations like virtualization, automation, and robust security. End-User Computing: Atea provides customized client hardware, software, and services, precisely tailored to address the unique requirements of users, applications, security protocols, network setups, and computing landscapes. Networking and Communications: The company supplies hardware and software for network operations, in addition to services designed to assist clients in managing their communication platforms effectively. Collaboration and Digital Productivity: They offer a variety of products aimed at fostering teamwork, including conferencing systems, information-sharing tools, and other digital productivity solutions. Modern Work Environments: Their digital workplace solutions integrate devices and software, enabling users to perform tasks, access data and applications, and interact seamlessly with colleagues. Specialized Services: This includes comprehensive information governance, IT asset lifecycle management, expert professional consulting, and continuous managed services.
